issues.concern: The gloss 'weekly publication' is too narrow. 週刊 can refer to anything weekly, not just publications.
The gloss 'weekly publication; weekly' is too narrow. 週刊 can refer to anything weekly, not just publications.

The English translation 'This manga is serialized weekly.' implies that the manga itself is serialized weekly, but the Japanese 'この漫画は週刊連載されている。' means that the serialization is weekly, not the manga itself.
issues.suggestion: This manga is serialized in weekly installments.
